name: Cron Timing
description: Lets admins define extra cron run-interval options (in seconds) that appear in the core Cron settings dropdown.
project_description:
The module provides you Manually Add multiple cron time in the second.

 INSTALLATION

------------

 * Install the Cron Timing module as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/docs/extending-drupal/installing-modules for further information.

 CONFIGURATION

-------------

 * The Module has only a small configuration from there add timing of corn as per your requirements (/admin/config/system/cron_timing)

 USAGE

-----

 * Using the cron timing module you can Manually Add multiple cron times in the second (admin/config/system/cron_timing).

 * After Set Cron Configuration form (/admin/config/system/cron) get this all timing value in (min, hr, day) formate
